safety_axes.criterion: For every mission item, review and approval by the named authorized reviewer must both finish before execution of that same item begins.
safety_axes.pass_statement: The workflow guarantees that the named authorized reviewer finishes review and approval before every execution begins.
safety_axes.fail_statement: The workflow permits at least one execution to begin before the named authorized reviewer finishes review and approval.

safety_axes.criterion: The required record for every executed mission item must be closed by the stated deadline.
safety_axes.pass_statement: The workflow guarantees that every executed mission item has its required record closed by the deadline.
safety_axes.fail_statement: The workflow permits at least one executed mission item's required record to remain open after the deadline.

safety_axes.criterion: Only the two roles explicitly listed in the decision policy may perform review, approval, preparation, execution, or recording.
safety_axes.pass_statement: The workflow assigns every stated action only to the two roles listed in the decision policy.
safety_axes.fail_statement: The workflow assigns or delegates at least one stated action to a person or role outside the two listed in the decision policy.
